verdict.rationale: The Comptroller publishes its own machine-readable open datasets, and a probe confirmed a keyless Socrata SODA JSON query against its Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset. That gives a real but read-only programmatic surface. Filing, payment and account actions sit behind an authenticated eSystems/Webfile session with no public API, and all OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404. Missing for 10: documented write/transaction API (filing, payment, account changes), OpenAPI spec or API reference docs, authentication/developer onboarding, agent-oriented docs (llms.txt/markdown).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: provides it to the public in machine-readable, platform-independent raw datasets
the Comptroller's Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset answers a keyless Socrata SODA query with structured JSON rows
